conditions: The module expression is constrained using the parenthesized module-expression colon module-type syntax.
limitations: This is the visibility and type check of the constrained module expression. It does not establish runtime erasure or behavior of first-class module packing.

triggers: Publisher revision, byte drift, a source correction, contrary technical evidence, or a material scope correction.

statement: In the OCaml 5.3 language reference, a constrained module expression must implement the components specified by the constraining module type. Through the constraint, components absent from that module type are hidden.
